    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge" targetRef="Task_PackageOrder"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_36" sourceRef="Event_IssueReported" targetRef="SubProcess_Returns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_37" sourceRef="SubProcess_Returns" targetRef="End_ReturnCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
